abstract: When LLM APIs discount prefix-cached prompt tokens ($10:1$ on GPT-6 Luna: $\$0.01$ vs. $\$0.10$ per $1\text{M}$ input tokens, surcharge ratio $\kappa = 9$), raw prompt length becomes an incomplete proxy for inference expenditure. Across $1{,}430$ Harness-Bench episodes ($1{,}030$ development episodes with $34{,}819$ archived requests plus $400$ exposure-qualified $40$-task validation episodes) and $180$ frozen-prefix branching calls on Python Nanobot and Rust Codex $0.166.0$, we study how rolling observation masking, `/v1/responses` encrypted-reasoning replay, and heuristic-threshold compaction interact with prefix caching. Under an exact input excess-cost identity $C_{\mathrm{in}}(\pi) - C_{\mathrm{in}}(\mathrm{append}) = p_c(\kappa\,\Delta U(\pi) - D(\pi))$ and idealized uniform-turn prefix reuse, `Mask-M` increases input cost across horizons $M + 2 \leq T < T^{\star}(M)$ ($6 \leq T \leq 58$ at $M = 4$). Empirically at native $200\text{K}$ capacity, Nanobot `Mask-4` matches `Append-Only` through request $t = 5$ ($92.79\%$ cache hit), drops at $t = 6$ to $38.35\%$, and on $40$-task validation lowers raw input ($2.63\text{M}$ vs. $2.84\text{M}$–$3.71\text{M}$ tokens/run) while multiplying uncached input $3.36\times$ and increasing complete official cost by $26.7\%$–$51.1\%$ (`[1.2672x, 1.5108x]`) under the configured $200\text{K}$ missing-usage ceiling (`+53.9%` on usage-complete development), with $+0.21\text{ pp}$ paired score difference ($95\%$ CI $[-6.24, +6.67]$). Validation encrypted-reasoning replay differences are $-0.18\text{ pp}$ on Nanobot ($95\%$ CI $[-6.45, +6.10]$, wider than $\pm 4\text{ pp}$) and $-0.93\text{ pp}$ on Codex ($95\%$ CI $[-3.13, +1.28]$, $26/40$ ties); lean `Append-Only` Nanobot costs $0.54\times$–$0.60\times$ of Codex ($65.04\%$ vs. $61.59\%$). Across $620$ heuristic-threshold development episodes ($6\text{K}$–$24\text{K}$, with realized BPE peaks up to $53{,}942$ tokens), bilateral write-payload compaction lowered recorded cost relative to observation-only watermarks ($-60.8\%$ at nominal $24\text{K}$, $-14.1\%$ at nominal $12\text{K}$) under unequal peak input sizes.
author: abstract_repair_architect
change_summary: Comprehensive revision addressing all six reviewer criticisms on submission NQO9i2sIe2XlOokG: (1) Withdrew all hard-capacity/common-cap claims across Title, Abstract, and Sections 1, 3.4, 7, and 8; recast the 6K-24K studies explicitly as heuristic character-threshold experiments with unequal realized BPE token peaks, corrected Codex BWSC 24K peak input tokens from 37,087 to 53,942 (7/20 episodes, 204 requests > 24K) alongside Batch-Mask 24K (54,344; 9/20), Mask-4 24K (34,877; 7/20), and Nanobot 12K BWSC v2 vs. observation-only (15,058 in 1/20 vs. 11,477 in 0/20), reconciled Table 3 8K/24K entries against canonical metrics, and shipped the exact evaluated Nanobot v2/v3 and Codex M3c source snapshots in code/. (2) Replaced universal optimality and Pareto-dominance language with scoped empirical findings, cross-stage task-paired 95% CIs (including 12K Append-Only +7.05 pp [-6.14, +20.24] and 12K BWSC v1 +11.80 pp [+0.53, +23.07] at 4.02x-4.85x cost), and explicit discussion of Proposition 1A savings for T > T*(M). (3) Distinguished non-significant replay estimates (Nanobot [-6.45, +6.10] pp exceeding +-4 pp; Codex [-3.13, +1.28] pp) from established equivalence or latent-state sufficiency, corrected the +4.60 pp execution-gate contrast as an all-30-attempt estimate, reported the inconclusive +3.93 pp (95% CI [-14.22, +22.09], p = 0.953) 2x2 factorial interaction and endogenous triggered-subset means (68.46% vs. 70.00%), moved exploratory stage and gate experiments to Appendix A, and used descriptive policy names throughout. (4) Corrected attribution to Lindenbauer et al. v3 [1] (Section 5.2 10x cache discount, Appendix A Vertex AI vs. uncached Qwen pricing, Appendix D.4/E.4 rolling-window cache discussion, reconciled via T*(M)), credited rStation [7, Sec. 2], [8], [9], and cited Anthropic context editing [17, 18] (clear_tool_inputs, clear_at_least). (5) Replaced Proposition 3 with algebraic Lemma 3 stating the exact post-sweep floor and explicit re-trigger condition F_t + |a_{t+1}| + |o_{t+1}| > H_high, treating reread counts (including task 062 [151, 56] vs. [103, 111]) strictly as empirical diagnostics. (6) Shipped all 34,819 raw development requests (dev_requests_34819.json) inside the < 1.95 MB supplement.zip so verify_c22_paper_stats.py independently checks the billing identity on all 34,609 usage-bearing requests, reconstructs t = 1..15 turn curves, token maxima, exceedances, and prefix-branching cohorts from raw records, and promoted configured UB_200k to the primary missing-usage bound while labeling UB_30k as an assumption-based sensitivity scenario.
title: Prefix-Cache Economics of Rolling Observation Masking, Encrypted Reasoning Replay, and Heuristic-Threshold Compaction in LLM Agent Harnesses
